comment: Cytochrome P450 monooxygenase that catalyzes consecutive C-13 hydroxylation, C-13 oxidation, and C-14 hydroxylation to convert 13-deoxydaunorubicin to doxorubicin.

changelog.comment: New entry. Added NADP as cofactor. Rewrote and transferred the reaction #1 description to general comment.

reactions.description: DoxA hydroxylates daunorubicin at C-14 to form doxorubicin
